title: Strawberry-Avocado Salad with Warm Chickpeas & Honey Mustard Dressing

steps.text: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, drain and rinse chickpeas.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chickpeas and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until chickpeas are golden brown, 5-6 minutes. Cover and remove from heat.
Meanwhile, place mayo, honey, water, Dijon, and salt in a large bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and thinly slice strawberries; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and thinly slice green onions; add to the bowl.
Chop or tear romaine into bite-sized pieces; add to the bowl.
Place corn in the colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost; add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Halve and pit avocados; cut crosswise while still in the skin, then scoop out with a spoon.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls; top with chickpeas and avocado. Enjoy!
